youtube.baslik: Can someone who never responds to sounds have a normal brainstem response? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: Cortical deafness usually results from damage to the auditory cortex on both sides, or to the pathways leading to it; the person seems to barely respond to sounds, yet the auditory brainstem response (ABR) is often normal. This dissociation shows that the problem is not in the ear but above the brainstem; these conditions are rare.
